title: fix(scenarios): seed a reference cycle in two passes; an author turn that does not finish leaves its build not measured
body:
Fixes #30982
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景跑批器(`@objectstack/scenarios` 的 runner)改为两遍加载种子数据,能装进 department ↔ employee 这类互相引用的环;构建提示词写明「环里至少一侧必须可选」,两侧都必填的构建记为 Build finding;构建回合超时或失败时 Build 半场记为「未测量」,不再打分、不再跑种子、Run 和 iterate;提示词改经 stdin 传给 `claude`。
- 为什么改:8 卡实跑里每张中档卡的种子只装进 3–6 行,Run 半场全部测不了;中档构建在第 15 分钟被 runner 自己杀掉却被当成 AI 质量分;travel_expense 和 service_desk 的构建回合根本没启动——实测是提示词超过 Linux 单个参数 128 KiB 的上限,`spawn` 直接报 E2BIG,记录里什么都没留下。
- 风险与回滚:只动私有、不发布的跑批器包,平台运行时零改动;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。两处没能在真机上实测:`claude -p` 从 stdin 读提示词、第二遍用 `PATCH /api/v1/data/OBJECT/ID` 回填引用;若有一处不成立,记录会如实写出退出码和 stderr,不会静默丢失。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/seed.ts`(`seedPlan`:强连通分量里挑可选的一侧推迟)、`src/runner/driver.ts` 的 `runCli`(stdin 传输、超时与进程记录)、`src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `seedApp` 第二遍和 `scratchMode` 的未测量提前返回。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`,预期 78 个测试全绿,其中 requisition_to_receipt 的种子 637/637 全部装入。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Defect 1 — the seed loads a reference cycle in two passes** (`src/runner/seed.ts`, new; `orchestrate.ts` `seedApp`).

- The references come from the card's own declared lookups (`expect.lookups` between two seeded objects), never a hand list. Objects go in dependencies first, one strongly connected set at a time (Tarjan; on an acyclic card this is exactly the depth-first order the runner already used).
- Inside a cycle, members go in by Kahn's algorithm; when every remaining member still waits on another, one whose waiting lookups are all **optional in the built schema** is let in early. Then every lookup value naming a row not yet in at its row's insert (a lookup to an object loaded later, or a self-lookup naming a later row of its own object) is left out of the insert and set by one `PATCH` per row in a second pass (`AppHarness.updateRow`, `HttpApp`: `PATCH /api/v1/data/OBJECT/ID`).
- The built schema's `required` lookup fields are read through the scorer's one artifact reader (`artifactToEvalGraph`), scratch mode from the built artifact, template mode from the installed copy.
- A cycle whose every lookup the build made `required` cannot be loaded. The build prompt's data contract now names the card's reference cycles and says "At least one side of a reference cycle must be optional" (`prompts.ts` `dataContract`, only on a card that has one), and the Build half records `requiredCycles`, which the scorecard lists as a Build finding naming the cycle. The seed is still sent, so the record holds the app's own refusals rather than the runner's prediction.
- The tally still counts each row once: a row whose second-pass update is refused moves from `inserted` to `refused` with the `fields` it could not set, and `seedDependence` takes what hangs off it out as before. `seed.secondPass` records the lookup values set per `OBJECT.FIELD`.

**Defect 2 — a build author turn that fails is recorded, and its Build half is not measured.**

- Measured cause: the build prompt carries the whole seed and was passed on argv. On Linux one argv string over 128 KiB (`MAX_ARG_STRLEN`, 131,072 bytes) makes `spawn` throw `E2BIG` before the CLI starts; `runCli` rejected, the author turn threw, and `RecordingDriver` recorded nothing. The two cards with no build author turn are exactly the two over the limit (readings below). The prompt now goes to the CLI's stdin (`claude -p`, no prompt argument), for question turns too.
- `runCli` never rejects: a process that could not start, was killed, or exited without a result is answered with what was seen — `meta.process`: elapsed ms, exit code or signal, whether the runner's timeout killed it, the stderr tail (2,000 chars), and a spawn or stdin error. It travels in the turn's `meta`, so a recording carries it and a replay re-reads a failed turn as the run saw it.
- `authorNotMeasured`: a turn without a clean `success` result line — no result line, an error subtype, or `is_error: true` (a usage limit answers `success` with it) — leaves its Build half `notMeasured: "author turn failed: …"`; a turn the driver threw on is the same, with its error. Nothing after it runs: no `os validate`/`build`/`verify`, no score, no seed, no Run, no iterate.

**Defect 3 — the authoring timeout is a runner option, and a killed turn is never a degraded score.**

- `--author-timeout MIN` (default `DEFAULT_AUTHOR_TIMEOUT_MIN = 60`, a plain constant: `card.tier` is not read) reaches `authorTimeoutMs`, which both the build and the iterate author turns use; the run record's `env.driver.authorTimeoutMs` and the console's driver line state it. A replay refuses the flag (it re-reads what was recorded).
- A turn the timeout killed makes its Build half `notMeasured: "author timed out after N min"`. An iterate author turn that does not finish leaves the first halves standing and the iterate build not measured, with no iterate Run half and no change size; template mode the same for its iterate.
- The scorecard prints `not measured: …` in the Build cell (0 of 0, never `degraded`), adds `Build · author` and `Iterate · author` rows with every authoring turn's `resultSubtype` and elapsed time, and the run record gives every half that did not run because of it the reason in `notes` (`not run: the build was not measured (…)`), verdict `not-run`.

Landing: all in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/**`, its tests and README, plus `test/export/fixture.ts` (outside the claim's file surface, only to give its `AppHarness` double the new `updateRow`). Not `src/schema.ts`, `src/loader.ts` or the card files. The gallery exporter's screenshot boot (`src/export/screenshots.ts`, unchanged) seeds through `seedApp` and inherits the two-pass load.

## Tests

- `test/runner/units.test.ts`, new top-level describes:
  - the seed's load plan on `requisition_to_receipt`: the cycle found from `expect.lookups`; departments first with five managers deferred; the side the build left optional is the one that waits (18 `employee.department` values when `department.manager` is required); both sides required names the cycle; `order_to_cash`'s `e09.manager → e10` self-reference waits; on every card in the library the first pass never names a row not in yet; the contract's cycle sentence.
  - the live `ClaudeCodeDriver` against a stand-in `claude` script (never the real CLI): a 200,000-byte prompt reaches it whole on stdin with argv under 1,000 bytes; a turn the timeout kills records `exit 143`, `timedOut`, elapsed and stderr tail and is `author timed out after …`; a crash and a vanished binary are failed turns with what was seen; `--author-timeout` parsing, its 60-min default and the replay refusal.
- `test/runner/app.test.ts`, new top-level describe: `HttpApp.updateRow` sends `PATCH /api/v1/data/OBJECT/ID` with the bare field patch to a loopback door, and reads a refusal's code and message.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, new top-level describes: a killed / failed / usage-limited / thrown build author turn, a killed iterate turn, and a failed template iterate turn, each not measured with nothing after it run; `seedApp` loading all 637 `requisition_to_receipt` rows into a double that checks reference integrity and `required` on insert and update; a refused second-pass update; `runCard` reporting a both-sides-required cycle as a Build finding.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` and `test`: green at the final head (readings below).

Reverse verification, each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restore proven `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The suites import `src/` directly, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Mutation | Expected | Observed |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `seed.ts`: no value is ever deferred | the cycle tests red | 9 failed / 69 passed |
| `driver.ts`: the build prompt back on argv | the 200 KB test red (`spawn E2BIG`, empty reply) | 1 failed / 50 passed, `Received: ""` |
| `orchestrate.ts`: delete the not-measured early return | the killed / failed build tests red | 2 failed / 25 passed |

## Acceptance notes

- `error_max_turns` counts as `author turn failed`: it is the runner's own turn budget (80), the same class as the timeout. A 60-minute mid-tier build that then runs out of turns will read not measured, not a cut-off score. No `--author-max-turns` option is added.
- The suggested route skipped the seed for a both-sides-required build. Here it is still sent: the finding names the cycle either way, and the record then shows whether the platform really refuses a missing required lookup on insert instead of assuming it.
- `buildPassed` is unchanged: a both-sides-required cycle is a finding, not a scored check (scoring stays `@objectstack/scenarios/score`), so such a build can still be the template mode's verified build; its template seed is refused the same way and recorded.
- Not measured live: `claude -p` reading its prompt from stdin (the CLI's help: `-p/--print … useful for pipes`, `--input-format text (default)`) and the `PATCH` data door against a real server (its shape is read from `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts`, and `app.ts` says so; the request the runner sends is pinned against a loopback door). The card's verification re-run settles both; if either fails, the turn or the second-pass refusal is in the record with its exit code, stderr or answer.
- Measured in the same class and covered without extra code: `order_to_cash`'s `e09.manager → e10` was refused by the object-by-object load, and `service_desk` has an `agent_group.lead ↔ agent.group` cycle.
- Changeset: none. `@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` and publishes nothing, so `skip-changeset`.
